title: Herbal Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with tender lamb, aromatic herbs, and a blend of spices. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add lemongrass, tagine spice, and herbal tea; stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the lamb, then bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in melted butter and chopped parsley.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
